extraction.method: BGRA threshold inside manually reviewed wall ROIs; binary closing radius 5 px orange/4 px grey; 4-connected regions; outer pixel-edge contours; RDP simplification 2 px
extraction.limitation: Colour regions can omit dark course outlines or pale masonry; polygons follow preserved coloured evidence, not ideal wall footprints. Grey mudbrick hatching is separated from irregular stone symbols by reviewed ROIs. Residual text/line pixels may survive; use overlay review, not blind extrusion.
